# Wishlist Requirements Quality Checklist: Personal Product Wishlist

**Purpose**: Review the completeness, clarity and consistency of ownership/privacy and wishlist contract/lifecycle requirements before implementation.
**Created**: 2026-10-30
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)
**Depth**: Standard
**Audience / Timing**: Reviewer, before implementation and during design/PR review
**Focus**: Ownership and privacy; contract/lifecycle consistency, including the four approved analysis remediations

**Note**: Generated by `$speckit-checklist` from the current feature and confirmed decisions. Scope, standard depth and reviewer audience are inferred from the ongoing pre-implementation workflow; no additional product requirements are introduced.
**Review Ownership**: This is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the written criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` records approval of requirements quality, not completed implementation or passing application tests. Generated items start unchecked; the authorized review below records their current disposition.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are the save, browse and remove capabilities, persistence across logout/login, and single personal wishlist boundary explicitly defined? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, §User Scenarios & Testing] **Review evidence**: spec.md FR-001 and Stories 1-3 define save/list/remove, one personal persisted list and logout/login retention.
- [x] CHK002 Are trusted ownership and the exclusion of caller-selected wishlist owners stated for every operation and error-disclosure path? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, §Request, Response and Error Contracts] **Review evidence**: spec.md FR-002, request/error contracts and Additional Authorization acceptance; contracts/domain-integration.md trusted owner boundaries and Removal reject owner selection and protect foreign membership.
- [x] CHK003 Are the permission policy and its effects on existing users, future registrations and custom-role accounts fully documented? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, §Confirmed Decisions] **Review evidence**: spec.md FR-003 / Confirmed Q1 B; data-model.md Migration; tasks.md T003/T004/T010/T021 distinguish existing/future USER grants and explicit custom-role permissions.
- [x] CHK004 Are the saved-item field allowlist, optional-image absence, timestamp representation and pagination metadata explicitly defined? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, §FR-011, §Request, Response and Error Contracts] **Review evidence**: spec.md FR-009/FR-011 and WishlistItem/WishlistPage contract; contracts/http.md Response bodies define exact nested allowlist, null image, UTC timestamp and visible pagination metadata.

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK005 Is whole-product membership clearly distinguished from variants, quantities, reservations and purchases? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005, §Explicit Exclusions] **Review evidence**: spec.md FR-005 and Explicit Exclusions define whole-product membership without variants/quantities/reservation/purchase behavior.
- [x] CHK006 Are duplicate addition and missing-entry removal described as successful no-ops with precise response and unchanged-state expectations? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006, §Request, Response and Error Contracts] **Review evidence**: spec.md FR-006 and Stories 1/3; HTTP duplicate 200 preserves item/time while absent removal 204 has no body or foreign-state change.
- [x] CHK007 Does the written duplicate policy clearly distinguish normal no-op success from actual persistence failure and subsequent recovery, without implying every duplicate requires a failed transaction? [Clarity, Spec §Request, Response and Error Contracts, §Remediation Decisions; Research §Atomic duplicate handling] **Review evidence**: spec.md Request, Response and Error Contracts / Remediation I1; research.md Atomic duplicate handling and integration Addition distinguish conflict-ignore success from real exceptions requiring rollback before translation.
- [x] CHK008 Is re-addition explicitly defined as a fresh timestamp sample without requiring strict increase, including the meaning of equal timestamps? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013, §User Story 3; Data Model §Lifecycle] **Review evidence**: spec.md FR-013, Story 3 scenario 3 and Remediation A1; data-model.md Lifecycle / integration Timestamp sampling explicitly allow equal samples and deterministic product UUID tie order.

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK009 Do ownership, authentication, permission and account/session eligibility requirements agree across the specification, contracts and story tasks? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002, §FR-003; Contracts §Security/error integration; Tasks T010, T021, T039] **Review evidence**: spec.md FR-002/FR-003; contracts/http.md and domain-integration.md Security/error integration; tasks.md T010/T021/T024/T039 preserve current account/session checks, MANAGE_WISHLIST and trusted ownership.
- [x] CHK010 Do the documents consistently preserve pair uniqueness and successful duplicate no-op behavior without introducing new pessimistic duplicate-resolution locking? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, §Remediation Decisions; Plan §Summary; Tasks T013, T016] **Review evidence**: spec.md FR-005 and Remediation I1; plan.md Summary; data-model.md Lifecycle; tasks.md T013/T016 retain targeted pair uniqueness and successful no-op duplicates without new pessimistic duplicate-resolution locks.
- [x] CHK011 Is the approved non-mutating listing exception clearly separated from duplicate handling and consistent across transaction and privacy requirements? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007, §Resolved Integration Conflict; Contracts §Listing] **Review evidence**: spec.md FR-007 / Resolved Integration Conflict; integration Listing and research Signing and transactions permit write-capable non-mutating listing solely for existing publication-safe signing, distinct from insertion.
- [x] CHK012 Do the written ordering, timestamp and retention rules agree across the specification, data model, contracts and tasks, including republishing versus re-addition? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008, §FR-010, §FR-013; Data Model §Lifecycle; Tasks T026, T036] **Review evidence**: spec.md FR-008/FR-010/FR-013; data-model.md Lifecycle and HTTP Response bodies; tasks.md T026/T036 preserve original time on republishing and sample fresh time only after removal/re-add.
- [x] CHK013 Are test organization, naming, responsibility boundaries and fixture guidance in plan/tasks consistent with the constitution, without introducing a competing convention? [Consistency, Spec §Remediation Decisions; Constitution §XIII; Plan §Technical Context, §Project Structure; Tasks §Format and Path Conventions] **Review evidence**: constitution.md XIII and plan.md Testing / Project Structure; tasks.md Format and Path Conventions / T002 / T003 align domain-layer responsibility classes, Test/IT categories, fixtures and isolated unit tests.

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK014 Are the primary story outcomes independently assessable from written preconditions and expected results rather than depending on unspecified behavior? [Measurability, Spec §User Scenarios & Testing, §SC-001–SC-006] **Review evidence**: spec.md each story has Independent Test and concrete Given/When/Then outcomes; SC-001-SC-006 bind retention/privacy/paging/removal/uniqueness/allowlists.
- [x] CHK015 Are pagination examples and measurable outcomes sufficient to distinguish accurate visible counts, full stable pages and deterministic tie ordering from post-page filtering? [Measurability, Spec §FR-007, §FR-009, §FR-010, §SC-003] **Review evidence**: spec.md FR-007/FR-009/FR-010 and SC-003 define 120 visible/30 hidden traversal at sizes 1/20/100; integration Listing and tasks.md T025/T032 exclude hidden rows before count/page and retain ties.
- [x] CHK016 Are simultaneous-add acceptance requirements distinct from sequential duplicate coverage, with explicit cardinality, response and timestamp expectations? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §Acceptance Verification Requirements, §SC-005; Tasks T015] **Review evidence**: spec.md simultaneous-add acceptance and SC-005; tasks.md T015 / integration Verification boundaries require overlapping real transactions, one 201/other 200, same time and exactly one row with stable publication.
- [x] CHK017 Are repository/migration requirements and real registration acceptance assigned distinct verification responsibilities, consistently separating T003 from T021? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §Remediation Decisions; Contracts §Testing boundaries; Tasks T003, T021] **Review evidence**: spec.md Remediation U1; integration Testing boundaries; tasks.md T003 repository/migration slice explicitly excludes real registration, which T021 assigns to real-service ControllerIT.

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK018 Are primary, alternate and recovery requirements documented for first save, repeated save, sign-out/sign-in persistence, removal and subsequent re-addition? [Coverage, Spec §User Stories 1–3, §FR-006, §FR-013] **Review evidence**: spec.md Stories 1-3 and FR-006/FR-013 cover first/repeated save, logout/login persistence, removal/no-op and re-add; integration Addition separates duplicate and actual persistence failure paths.
- [x] CHK019 Are hiding, retained membership, republishing and hidden-product removal all covered without conflicting lifecycle rules? [Coverage, Spec §FR-008, §FR-012; Data Model §Lifecycle] **Review evidence**: spec.md FR-008/FR-012; data-model.md Lifecycle / integration Removal retain hidden membership, restore original time and permit hidden removal without public lookup.
- [x] CHK020 Are failure and rollback requirements complete for invalid input, permission denial, missing/nonpublic products, signing unavailability and actual persistence exceptions? [Coverage, Spec §FR-015, §Request, Response and Error Contracts; Contracts §Addition] **Review evidence**: spec.md FR-015 and failure table; integration Addition / Verification boundaries and tasks.md T014/T019/T022 define safe validation/auth/visibility/signing/FK errors and real rollback before translation.
- [x] CHK021 Are concurrent removal/addition and product-visibility changes assigned documented safe outcomes, with clear limits on snapshot and retry promises? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases; Contracts §Addition, §Listing; Tasks T022, T026] **Review evidence**: spec.md Edge Cases; integration Addition handles concurrent disappearance as 409; Listing handles late eligibility as 409 without shortened success pages and disclaims stronger READ COMMITTED snapshots/retries; tasks.md T022/T026 verify these.

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK022 Are omitted, empty, explicit-null, malformed, repeated, out-of-range and unsupported request inputs distinguished in the written contract? [Coverage, Spec §Request, Response and Error Contracts; HTTP Contract §Inputs] **Review evidence**: spec.md request validation and contracts/http.md Inputs distinguish omitted defaults, empty/text-null/noncanonical/duplicate/out-of-range pagination, invalid UUIDs, unknown keys/sort and supplied JSON bodies including null/{}.
- [x] CHK023 Are empty lists, beyond-last pages, missing images and equal timestamps covered with unambiguous outcomes? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 2, §FR-009, §FR-010, §FR-011] **Review evidence**: spec.md Story 2 and FR-009-FR-011; HTTP Response bodies define empty/beyond-last lists and totals, null image and product UUID tie-breaking for equal times.
- [x] CHK024 Are physical-parent cleanup rules clearly distinguished from soft visibility changes and membership removal, while preserving unrelated parent-lifecycle constraints? [Coverage, Spec §FR-012, §FR-014; Data Model §Constraints and indexes, §Lifecycle] **Review evidence**: spec.md FR-008/FR-012-FR-014; data-model.md Constraints and indexes / Lifecycle distinguish dependent physical cleanup from soft visibility and ordinary membership removal, with unrelated parent FKs left intact.

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK025 Are nondisclosure requirements explicit for foreign membership, unpublished metadata, image access and sensitive error information? [Security, Spec §FR-002, §FR-004, §FR-008, §FR-015, §SC-002] **Review evidence**: spec.md FR-002/FR-004/FR-008/FR-015 and SC-002; HTTP Errors and integration Listing/Removal prohibit foreign membership, hidden metadata/new URLs and sensitive error disclosure.
- [x] CHK026 Are previously issued image-access expiry, private-response caching and durable-data privacy expectations described consistently? [Security, Spec §Edge Cases, §Request, Response and Error Contracts; HTTP Contract §Response bodies] **Review evidence**: spec.md Edge Cases / response contract and HTTP Response bodies preserve existing five-minute catalog capability expiry, no-store responses, no URL persistence and no immediate post-unpublish revocation promise.
- [x] CHK027 Are bounded retrieval and response-usability requirements objectively scoped, including the measurement boundary and absence of an unsupported load/latency promise? [Measurability, Spec §FR-016, §Persistence and Domain Integration; Plan §Technical Context; Tasks T031] **Review evidence**: spec.md FR-016 / Persistence and Domain Integration; plan.md Performance Goals; integration Listing and tasks.md T031 bound <=6 feature SQL statements for 1/100 imaged pages excluding auth/fixtures, materialize DTOs and impose no load/latency SLA.

## Authorized Review Disposition (2026-10-30)

Reviewed at the user's request against all feature-folder artifacts: spec.md, plan.md, data-model.md, research.md, quickstart.md, tasks.md and both contracts, plus current constitution XIII and a source inventory / ProductCatalogService interface check. **32/32 requirements-quality criteria satisfied; zero unchecked items.** Inline evidence identifies the satisfied criterion and supporting sections.

The four approved analysis remediations are consistently reflected: targeted conflict-ignore duplicate success without exception recovery/new pessimistic duplicate locks; repository/migration slice versus real registration acceptance separation; fresh re-add timestamp sample with equal values permitted; constitution-owned domain/layer test responsibilities and fixture organization. The non-mutating write-capable listing exception remains restricted to existing publication-safe signing.

Historical plan/spec generation labels such as ready for planning or tasks not generated describe earlier workflow stages; the current tasks.md supplies the actual work plan. These labels do not claim implementation completion or override current contracts. The current source has catalog capabilities but no wishlist production domain; ProductCatalogService currently exposes listProducts/getProduct, consistent with the documented new integration needs. No runtime tests were run, and no concurrency/query/HTTP acceptance is claimed as executed.

Only checklists/wishlist.md changed in this review. requirements.md, all other feature artifacts, production source, dependencies, migrations and existing user changes remain untouched. These markers approve written requirements quality only, not implemented software, dependency approval or release readiness.
